import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Fraud distribution pie chart
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
fraud_counts = df['is_fraud'].value_counts()
colors = ['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c']
ax1.pie(fraud_counts.values, labels=['Legitimate', 'Fraud'], autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax1.set_title('Fraud vs Legitimate Transactions', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 2. Transaction amount distribution by fraud status
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1:])
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='is_fraud', y='amount', ax=ax2, palette=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'])
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticklabels(['Legitimate', 'Fraud'])

# 3. Fraud by hour of day
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])
fraud_by_hour = df.groupby('hour_of_day')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
fraud_by_hour['fraud_rate'] = (fraud_by_hour['sum'] / fraud_by_hour['count']) * 100
ax3_twin = ax3.twinx()
bars = ax3.bar(fraud_by_hour.index, fraud_by_hour['count'], alpha=0.6, color='#3498db', label='Total Transactions')
line = ax3_twin.plot(fraud_by_hour.index, fraud_by_hour['fraud_rate'], color='#e74c3c', 
                      marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=6, label='Fraud Rate (%)')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11, color='#3498db')
ax3_twin.set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=11, color='#e74c3c')
ax3.set_title('Transaction Volume and Fraud Rate by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#3498db')
ax3_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#e74c3c')
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
lines1, labels1 = ax3.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax3_twin.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax3.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper left')

# 4. Transaction type distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
type_fraud = df.groupby('transaction_type')['is_fraud'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
type_fraud.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax4, color='#e74c3c', alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Number of Fraud Cases', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Fraud Cases by Transaction Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Fraud rate by transaction type
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
fraud_rate_by_type = df.groupby('transaction_type')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
fraud_rate_by_type['rate'] = (fraud_rate_by_type['sum'] / fraud_rate_by_type['count']) * 100
fraud_rate_by_type = fraud_rate_by_type.sort_values('rate', ascending=True)
bars = ax5.barh(fraud_rate_by_type.index, fraud_rate_by_type['rate'], color='#f39c12', alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_ylabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    width = bar.get_width()
    ax5.text(width, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{width:.1f}%', 
             ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Amount scatter by hour with fraud highlighted
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
legitimate = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]
fraud = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]
ax6.scatter(legitimate['hour_of_day'], legitimate['amount'], alpha=0.3, s=20, 
            c='#2ecc71', label='Legitimate')
ax6.scatter(fraud['hour_of_day'], fraud['amount'], alpha=0.8, s=50, 
            c='#e74c3c', marker='^', edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5, label='Fraud')
ax6.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour (Fraud Highlighted)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.legend()
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

plt.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
